test_try_get_episode_indices: test the AppStateStartSession._try_get_episode_indices method with various connected user episode scenarios
test_episode_indices_single_user: test _try_get_episode_indices with a single connected user providing comma-separated episode strings
test_episode_indices_multi_user_match: test _try_get_episode_indices with two connected users providing matching episode selections
test_episode_indices_invalid_input: test _try_get_episode_indices returns None for invalid input types like None, int, float, or dict
test_episode_indices_out_of_range: test _try_get_episode_indices returns None when episode indices are negative or exceed total episode count
